title: wg: room-policy-04 §5 call-room example contradicts itself
description: §5 (L542) cites a call room that is both fixed-membership and parent-dependent 'in a Group DM'; the strict-subset rule forbids it containing all Group DM participants and §5 (L530) 'only a single fixed-membership room per participant set' forbids duplicating the Group DM's set. Fix the example or the rules. Found by the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18.
